name: Founder decision: Ratify the work style grid's team use as none but one upward use
text_content:
P30, answering carryovers 86akh7qq7, 86akhb2wj, and 86akhcz6v. The grid stays inside a lead's working-with-me document and Session 1's instrument on the team home, and has no team use beyond them, because a language a team uses about itself on a roster that dissolves nightly is a language people use about each other (her own example is a leader calling a colleague "red" in a meeting, Book p.328), the record's vocabulary for difference is the strands as two kinds of work, a typology on a floor becomes a placement within a week, an hourly person is never asked to write the document, and the person page refuses a rating. The one narrow use is upward and one-directional: a lead's domain may use the lead's own self-placement about the lead at the check-in's fourth question and on the channel, because the lead wrote it for that reason. Its four names on any person page, scorecard, schedule note, designation block, brief record, close, sheet, or leads' review line fail row 120; a check-in line saying a lead placed a person on it is a range breach on the lead's entry. Blocks row 120. Normal.
